description: clustarr's manager, agents, markers and engines: work queues, search and grabs, imports, transcodes, markers, subtitles, Live TV, the remediation loop and NATS. Every series is clustarr_*, filtered by namespace.

panels.title: Manager leader
panels.description: 1 while a manager replica holds the lease. No leader means no reconcile, dispatch or admission runs.

panels.title: Work pending
panels.description: Messages waiting in every work queue, summed over durables.

panels.title: Dispatches waiting
panels.description: Dispatches the manager has not yet admitted to a durable.

panels.title: Unattended durables
panels.description: Durables with work and no agent taking it: an agent domain scaled to zero or wedged.

panels.title: Saturated subscriptions
panels.description: Subscriptions whose every slot a lapsed handler holds; the pod fetches nothing for them.

panels.title: Fullest stream
panels.description: The highest stored-bytes share of any JetStream stream. At 100% a DiscardOld stream drops its oldest messages.

panels.title: Transcode backlog
panels.description: Files eligible for a TranscodeProfile's window that admission holds.

panels.title: Transcodes running
panels.description: Transcode jobs active across every hardware tier.

panels.title: Live TV viewers
panels.description: Viewers attached to the tuner's relay, every provider.

panels.title: Abandoned FFmpeg calls
panels.description: In-process FFmpeg calls that outlived their context. At 4 in one process it reports itself wedged and restarts.

panels.title: Unreaped par2 children
panels.description: par2 repair processes past their deadline and grace: a read blocked in the kernel.

panels.title: Text detector loaded
panels.description: 1 on every markers pod whose ONNX Runtime and text-detection model loaded.

panels.title: Pending work by durable
panels.description: Messages waiting in each work queue (only durables that had work in the range).

panels.title: Delivered, not settled
panels.description: NumAckPending: deliveries in flight on each durable.

panels.title: Dispatches waiting admission
panels.description: Dispatches the ledger has not admitted yet, by durable.

panels.title: Nak and term advisories
panels.description: JetStream nak and term advisories of dispatched tasks, per minute.

panels.title: Task ack delay (p90)
panels.description: Sampled delivery-to-ack time of dispatched tasks, 90th percentile.

panels.title: Deliveries per acked task (mean)
panels.description: Deliveries a task took before its ack. Above 1 means redeliveries.

panels.title: Stream fill
panels.description: Stored bytes over MaxBytes, per stream.

panels.title: Grab candidates
panels.description: Grab candidates the manager's intake handled, per minute.

panels.title: Indexer queries
panels.description: Queries to each indexer, per minute, by outcome.

panels.title: Indexer query time and wait (mean)
panels.description: Mean time an indexer took to answer a query once it was sent, and the mean time queries waited for their turn on the indexer's requestDelay before that (clustarr_indexer_query_wait_seconds). A rising wait with a flat query time is searches queueing in clustarr, not a slow indexer.

panels.title: Release decisions
panels.description: Release decisions per minute: approved, rejected, refused, grabbed and the rest.

panels.title: Top rejection reasons
panels.description: Rejected and refused releases over the dashboard's range, by reason.

panels.title: Metadata cache hit ratio
panels.description: The metadata gateway's L1 (memory) and L2 (NATS KV) cache.

panels.title: Engine commands
panels.description: Add (present) and remove (absent) commands the manager published to the download engines.

panels.title: Probes
panels.description: MediaFile probes in the import agent, per minute.

panels.title: Backlog by profile
panels.description: Files a profile's window holds in memory for admission.

panels.title: Encode speed
panels.description: Encode speed relative to real time.

targets.expr: sum by (tier, resolution) (rate(clustarr_transcode_duration_seconds_sum{namespace="$namespace"}[$__rate_interval])) / sum by (tier, resolution) (rate(clustarr_transcode_duration_seconds_count{namespace="$namespace"}[$__rate_interval]))

sum by (tier, resolution) (rate(clustarr_transcode_size_ratio_sum{namespace="$namespace"}[$__rate_interval])) / sum by (tier, resolution) (rate(clustarr_transcode_size_ratio_count{namespace="$namespace"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: Ledger corrections
panels.description: Admission ledger entries a resync's quorum read corrected.

panels.title: Files analyzed
panels.description: Marker analyses, by result and the source of the strongest segment.

panels.title: Analysis busy time by stage
panels.description: Seconds spent per second in each stage: fingerprint (audio), frames (end frames) and dnn (text detection).

panels.title: Records incorporated
panels.description: Worker answers (probes, transcodes, grafts, markers) the remediation loop folded into MediaFile status.

panels.title: Upstream errors and dropped viewers
panels.description: Upstream failures, and viewers cut off for falling a whole ring behind.

targets.expr: sum by (provider, source) (rate(clustarr_livetv_fetch_duration_seconds_sum{namespace="$namespace"}[$__rate_interval])) / sum by (provider, source) (rate(clustarr_livetv_fetch_duration_seconds_count{namespace="$namespace"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: Passes
panels.description: Remediation loop passes per minute, by key kind and outcome.

targets.expr: sum by (kind, phase) (rate(clustarr_remediation_pass_seconds_sum{namespace="$namespace"}[$__rate_interval])) / sum by (kind, phase) (rate(clustarr_remediation_pass_seconds_count{namespace="$namespace"}[$__rate_interval]))

sum by (planner, effect) (rate(clustarr_remediation_effect_seconds_sum{namespace="$namespace"}[$__rate_interval])) / sum by (planner, effect) (rate(clustarr_remediation_effect_seconds_count{namespace="$namespace"}[$__rate_interval]))

sum by (planner, phase) (rate(clustarr_remediation_planner_seconds_sum{namespace="$namespace"}[$__rate_interval])) / sum by (planner, phase) (rate(clustarr_remediation_planner_seconds_count{namespace="$namespace"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: Pass reads
panels.description: Gets within a pass, answered from the pass's first decode (hit) or decoded again.

panels.title: Filesystem calls
panels.description: The loop's /data calls, by operation and outcome.

panels.title: Lapsed handlers
panels.description: Handlers past their delivery's deadline that still run.

panels.title: Muted acks and naks
panels.description: InProgress and Nak calls of lapsed deliveries the bus muted.

panels.title: Slow-consumer drops
panels.description: Messages dropped from a core subscription's buffer (ClustarrNATSSlowConsumer).

panels.title: Orphan chunks purged
panels.description: Object-store chunks no object names, reclaimed by the maintenance loop.

panels.title: CPU
panels.description: Cores used.

panels.title: Process starts
panels.description: A bar where a process restarted.

title: Clustarr
